purpose: makes a new file from the template of the rule that governs it

file.description: what to make; this release makes files alone

<path>.description: the new file, relative to the repository root wherever the command runs. An absolute path inside the repository is accepted. A path outside it is refused.

--rule.description: the rule whose template to use. Default: the most specific rule that governs the path and has templates. A script with no extension needs this flag.

--variant.description: the template to use. Default: the first variant the rule lists that the path allows.

--<hole>.description: the value of a hole («name») within a line of the template. The holes path, name, and stem default to values taken from the path. Every other hole needs its flag.
